tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background. Every text color below is checked on it. Cool white and deep teal-black; never cream, beige or inverted light.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Neutral sunken ground for code blocks and quiet groups. Ink, comment, soft and every role text color hold 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and sections. Decorative only: never carries meaning, never text.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Field borders, checkbox outlines, secondary button borders. Non-text mark: 3.3:1 or better on page, panel and every tint in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, the header rule. 14.9:1 on page, 13.8:1 on panel (light); 15.2:1 on page (dark).

tokens.name: comment
tokens.usage: Secondary text and labels on page, panel and every tint. 5.3:1 on page (light), 7.7:1 (dark).

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Secondary prose: longer supporting paragraphs. 5.6:1 on page (light), 9.2:1 (dark).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Role: links and private routes. Text-safe on page and every tint (5.3:1 light, 8.4:1 dark). The Bridgewater signature hue.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Role: public, OK, selected. Text-safe on page and every tint (5.2:1 light, 9.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Role: counts and section numbers, set in mono. Text-safe on page and every tint (5.8:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: amber-text
tokens.usage: Role: needs attention. The text-safe amber (5.0:1 on page, 4.6:1 on panel, light; 9.6:1 dark). Use it for words and dots; amber below is for fills.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Role: down, failed. Text-safe on page and every tint (5.2:1 light, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Role: destructive and wrong. The Delete button, an invalid field, a message that something cannot be undone. It is what you did or must fix; orange stays for what the system did (down, failed). Text-safe on page and every tint (5.7:1 on page, 5.3:1 on panel, 5.2:1 on its tint, light; 6.4:1 dark). Never a signature.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Signature of jordan sites, as a fill and mark: strip, wordmark dot, panel rule. 3.8:1 on the light page, so never light-theme text; use pink-text for words. In dark it passes as text too (7.5:1).

tokens.name: pink-text
tokens.usage: Role: jordan signature, the text-safe pink. 5.3:1 on page and 4.95:1 on panel and pink-tint (light); the same as pink in dark (7.5:1). Used for the prompt path, links and the primary button fill on pink sites, with on-fill text (5.5:1 light).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Fill only, for amber-signature sites: strip and primary button, always under ink text (6.3:1 light). 2.4:1 on the light page by design, so it is never text or a thin line; amber words and dots use amber-text (5.0:1).

tokens.name: teal-bright
tokens.usage: Fill and mark only: the strip end, wordmark dot, logo summit. 4.1:1 on the light page, which clears the 3:1 mark rule but is not a text color; text uses teal (5.3:1).

tokens.name: green-bright
tokens.usage: Fill and mark only: strip end and wordmark dot on green sites. 3.2:1 on the light page, which clears the 3:1 mark rule but is not a text color; text uses green.

tokens.name: orange-bright
tokens.usage: Fill and mark only: strip end and wordmark dot on orange sites. 3.1:1 on the light page, which clears the 3:1 mark rule but is not a text color; text uses orange.

tokens.name: teal-tint
tokens.usage: Panel ground for the one thing that stands apart, in the teal role (6% in light, 14% in dark). Ink, comment, soft and all role text colors hold 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Panel ground for the one thing that stands apart, in the green role (6% in light, 14% in dark). Ink, comment, soft and all role text colors hold 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: purple-tint
tokens.usage: Panel ground for the one thing that stands apart, in the purple role (6% in light, 14% in dark). Ink, comment, soft and all role text colors hold 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: amber-tint
tokens.usage: Panel ground for the one thing that stands apart, in the amber role (6% in light, 14% in dark). Ink, comment, soft and all role text colors hold 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: orange-tint
tokens.usage: Panel ground for the one thing that stands apart, in the orange role (6% in light, 14% in dark). Ink, comment, soft and all role text colors hold 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: red-tint
tokens.usage: Panel ground for the one thing that stands apart, in the red role (6% in light, 14% in dark). Ink, comment, soft and all role text colors hold 4.5:1 on it (worst: amber-text, 4.52 light).

tokens.name: pink-tint
tokens.usage: Panel ground for the one thing that stands apart, in the pink role (6% in light, 14% in dark). Ink, comment, soft and all role text colors hold 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text on teal, green, purple and orange fills (button labels). 5.3 to 5.9:1 in light; 7.8 to 9.9:1 on the bright dark fills.

tokens.name: on-bright
tokens.usage: Text on amber and pink fills (ink in both themes: dark text on light fills, near-black on the dark theme's bright fills). 6.3:1 on amber light; pink light measures 3.9:1, see DESIGN.

tokens.name: sig
tokens.usage: Signature as text: the prompt path, links on a signature site. Aliases the site's role color; override with data-sig on html.

tokens.name: sig-fill
tokens.usage: Signature as a fill that carries text: primary button, letter tile. Pair with on-sig.

tokens.name: sig-bright
tokens.usage: Signature as a pure mark: strip end, wordmark dot, summit dot. No text on it.

tokens.name: sig-tint
tokens.usage: Signature panel ground.

tokens.name: on-sig
tokens.usage: Text on sig-fill.

signatures.usage: bridgewater.digital, the root site. The default.
Purple sites. Purple has no bright strength, so its mark is purple itself.
audible. Amber fills carry on-bright text; amber words use amber-text.
jordan sites. Words and the button use pink-text; the strip and dot stay pink.

illustration.name: quiet
illustration.usage: Illustration only, never UI: the far ridge of the Hood skyline and the circuit tile traces. Quieter than line-strong; not a CSS variable.

illustration.name: quiet-strong
illustration.usage: Illustration only, never UI: the vias of the circuit tile, between quiet and line-strong. Not a CSS variable.

families.mono: "Fira Code", "Fira Code Fallback", ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page, home and landing headers. Ink.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title, preceded by its section number in mono purple.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Words go in the sans, machine facts in the mono.
styles.usage: Paragraphs. Ink on page, panel and tints; soft for secondary prose.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row names and emphasis inside body.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, captions. Comment or soft.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and button text. Sentence case, never uppercase, never letter-spaced.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Hostnames, counts, states, paths. Never a paragraph.

styles.name: prompt
styles.usage: The prompt line: user, host, colon, then the signature-colored path.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, dot to word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between tightly related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, field label to control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones, between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding, between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section breaks on wide pages.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, tiles. Square-leaning: no pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Rare: image frames only.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Row and section separators in line.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The header rule in ink and the panel's top rule in its role color.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Field and secondary button borders in line-strong.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring in sig, offset 2px.

tokens.name: strip-height
tokens.usage: Height of the signature strip.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and fields.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons and toolbar controls.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: App and letter tile.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for prose.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum page width.
